choices.label: Coordinate a quiet search
choices.impact: Morris organizes a discreet search beyond the station. Morris can watch for danger, but he needs you to share each clue before he can act.
choices.response: Morris organizes a discreet search beyond the station. Ethan must come home alive.
choices.speaker: Detective Morris

choices.label: Decode the next lead with Amara
choices.impact: David checks the technical evidence. Amara connects it to the people and history behind the records, without police assistance.
choices.response: David preserves the original record and tests the next connection while Amara checks its meaning against what she remembers.
choices.speaker: David

choices.label: Visit the witness myself
choices.impact: A witness tells David which forest trail Victor used. You can investigate quietly, but no one will be close enough to help immediately if Victor is waiting.
choices.response: A witness tells David which forest trail Victor used. Ethan must come home alive.
choices.speaker: David

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The van carries a stolen plate. The public camera archive shows it heading north, but a direction is not a location.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Victor always wanted an audience for his victories. He may have left one camera running on purpose. Check what the image does not show.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: A second camera catches the turn toward the forest. I saved both originals before making a copy for comparison.

police.speaker: David
police.text: Morris compares the witness statement with a patrol report. Both place the van near the forest road.

signal.speaker: David
signal.text: I identify a second device moving beyond the station. Someone is carrying it toward the forest.

alone.speaker: David
alone.text: The witness trusts me with a detail left out of the report: Victor changed vehicles beside the forest road.
